dwgmir.mirror_tip: Mirror the picked primitives across an axis through their centre
dwgmir.scale_tip: Scale the picked primitives about their centre; the factor must be above zero
dwgmir.len_tip: Pick one line, type its real length: the picked primitives are scaled about their centre by typed length / current length
dwgmir.st.len_one_line: Pick exactly one line as the reference
dwgmir.st.len_zero: The picked line has zero length
dwgmir.st.whole_refused: Pick primitives first: a whole drawing cannot be mirrored or scaled here
dwgmir.st.axis_bad: The mirror axis needs two different points
dwgmir.st.scale_bad: The scale factor must be a number above zero
dwgmir.st.scale_one: Nothing to do: the factor is 1
dwgmir.st.len_parse: The length must be a number above zero, e.g. 2500 mm or 2.5 m
dwgmir.ref_tip: Keep the picked line length as the reference, then pick other primitives or the whole drawing and scale by typed length / reference
dwgmir.ref_apply_tip: Scale the picked set (or the whole drawing) so the reference line gets the typed length
dwgmir.st.ref_stale: No valid reference: the drawing changed, pick a line and use it as reference again
